title: geodesic-anomaly-test: Information-geometric hypothesis testing on the categorical statistical manifold
description: Reference implementation, simulations, analytic finite-sample checks, and real-data (NSL-KDD) experiment for information-geometric hypothesis testing on the categorical statistical manifold. Includes the exact relation to the Freeman-Tukey/Hellinger statistic and the revised non-correctability calculation.
